text: TCU: Office of Financial Aid How To Apply/Important Dates Need-Based Financial Aid: Submit the Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA) online at http://www.fafsa.gov . TCU’s school code is 003636 . This data is used to determine eligibility for Federal and State aid. Also, please submit the CSS profile online at http://student.collegeboard.org/css-financial-aid-profile . TCU’s school code is 6820. The application costs $25 for one school and $16 for every additional school. Data from the CSS Profile is used solely for awarding institutionally funded aid. Academic Scholarships Apply for admission to the University by February 15. (No additional application is necessary.) Scholarship recipients will be notified in mid March. Fine Arts Awards Auditions for these awards generally take place at the beginning of the spring semester. Please schedule auditions by early January. To schedule an audition, contact the specific department. Addresses and phone numbers are listed under performance awards . Recipients will be notified in April. Other Financial Aid Please contact the TCU Office of Scholarships and Student Financial Aid for information on any other assistance programs. Important Dates/ Timeline October – Incoming freshmen and transfers need to file a CSS profile to be considered for institutionally funded aid. New undergraduate students who are applying in the “Early Decision” admission group may begin filing the CSS Profile on or after Oct 1 and must have their completed applications submitted no later than November 1. Early Action and Regular admission students do not need to apply for aid until after January 1. Apply at http://student.collegeboard.org/css-financial-aid-profile . December – Academic scholarship notifications begin and continue through March December – Schedule your audition or submit your portfolio. Auditions and portfolio review for fine arts awards generally take place at the beginning of the spring term. Contact the department directly for instructions. January 1 – FAFSA (Free Application for Federal Student Aid) available for submission for upcoming academic year at www.fafsa.ed.gov . February 15 – Freshman admission application deadline to be considered for academic scholarship (see Admissions website for details) March 15 – Undergraduate students and incoming freshmen should complete the FAFSA by this date in order to insure notification of award before the May 1 national school commitment date. Priority funding deadline for incoming freshmen. May 1 – Returning Student Priority Funding Deadline: If FAFSA is received by TCU on or before May 1, student will be evaluated for all types of need-based aid (grants, work-study, and loans). FAFSA submitted after May 1 will be reviewed on a funds-available basis. Returning students do not need to apply for the CSS profile. July – Bill for fall term is sent via email from the Office of Student Financial Services August 1 – First payment for fall term is due. Transfer student priority funding deadline for financial aid.
